name: Noum: Communication Coach
subtitle: Evidence-led speaking coach
promotionalText: Practice the conversation before it matters. Noum listens for patterns, quotes your own words as evidence, and gives you one focused next rep.
description:
Speak more clearly when the stakes rise.

Noum is an evidence-led communication coach for meetings, interviews, presentations, and difficult conversations. Complete a short spoken rep, see what the evidence supports, and follow a focused plan that adapts as you practice.

WHAT NOUM HELPS YOU TRAIN
• Clear, structured answers under time pressure
• Filler-word control without punishing meaningful speech
• Pace, pauses, delivery, and conversational response
• Concise recommendations and confident openings
• Preparation for a real upcoming moment

COACHING YOU CAN INSPECT
Noum can quote verified words from your saved reps, distinguish an early signal from a repeated pattern, and say when there is not enough evidence yet. You can inspect, correct, export, or delete coaching memory.

A PLAN, NOT A WALL OF EXERCISES
Noum recommends one next rep from your current focus. You can still browse the complete practice library whenever you want.

FREE AND PRO
Core speaking practice remains free. Noum Pro adds deeper coaching, Ask Noum, transcripts, trends, and supported advanced analysis. Available products and introductory offers are shown from the App Store before purchase.

Noum does not diagnose personality, read motives, guarantee real-world outcomes, or replace the judgment of a qualified human coach.
